lines.zh: 我从树的影子里走出来
lines.en: I step out of the tree's shadow

lines.zh: 我的动作和本体错开半拍
lines.en: My movements lag half a beat behind the original
I don't break a single blade of grass
I circle, one step at a time
My outline slides along the ground

lines.zh: 我在你身后出现，又消失
lines.en: I appear behind you, then I'm gone
The light dims where I walk

lines.zh: 我和另一道影子换了个位置
lines.en: Another shadow and I trade places
My fingers trail over the ground
I walk in the fog, and the fog follows
I don't watch where you walk

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚步的影子走
lines.en: I walk inside the shadow of your steps
I stand, indistinguishable from the tree's shadow
I make no sound of breathing
I wait, and keep waiting

lines.zh: 我的轮廓轻轻抖了一下
lines.en: My outline quivers once
Fog creeps along the ground this way
I'm counting how many steps you've taken
My face is empty
The lamplight ends at my side
My hand lifts and falls
I stand shoulder to shoulder with another shadow
This room is too bright for me
I wait for you to put the lamp out
A root shifts underground

lines.zh: 我低头看自己，什么也没有
lines.en: I look down at myself and find nothing
You hold up a light; I stand outside it
The more you look, the clearer I get
There's more than one of us
The one you struck wasn't me
I'm on both your sides
Your torch doesn't reach the corners

lines.zh: 我数了三个，你数了几个
lines.en: I count three; how many do you count
You've backed under the lamp; good
We ring you and don't strike
I raise a hand; so do you
Your shadow is shorter than I am
Don't chase me; you won't catch me
I stand between you and the door
You shout once, and nothing answers

lines.zh: 我们学你说话，学得不像
lines.en: We copy your voice, badly
Can you tell which one is me

lines.zh: 我在你的灯照不到的地方
lines.en: I'm out of your lamp's reach

lines.zh: 你走了三步，我还是三个
lines.en: You take three steps and there are still three
I come apart and gather again
A piece of my outline is missing
I withdraw into the fog again
There's no blood where I was struck
I ripple like water

lines.zh: 另一道影子替我顶上来
lines.en: Another shadow steps in for me
Another layer fades from my outline

lines.zh: 我退了一步，你追上来了
lines.en: I fall back a step; you follow
Not even my shadow stirs
I lower my head and the fog thickens

lines.zh: 你的灯光是最好吃的东西
lines.en: Your lamplight is the finest thing to eat
Bright things pull me close
Lower that torch a little
I reach out and the light retreats
This light is only enough to share
You hold it, and it bothers me
We're all watching that flame
A little wind and it shrinks
Stand under the lamp; we'll wait
When the light dies, don't turn
You hit me like plunging into cold mist

lines.zh: 我散开，又在你身后合拢
lines.en: I scatter and close again behind you

lines.zh: 我的手碰到你的肩，很轻
lines.en: My hand touches your shoulder, lightly
You pass through one of us

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，影子叠影子
lines.en: We crowd together, shadow on shadow

lines.zh: 我退开，让你以为过去了
lines.en: I give way so you think you're through

lines.zh: 你撞在树上，我们都在看
lines.en: You hit a tree; we all watch

lines.zh: 这一下我该散的，没有散
lines.en: That should have scattered me; it didn't
Your shoulder is warm
We press close and won't let you leave

lines.zh: 另一道影子从雾里过来
lines.en: Another shadow comes out of the fog

lines.zh: 我们重叠在一起，分不清
lines.en: We overlap until we can't be told apart
It's darker than I am

lines.zh: 我们同时抬手，同时放下
lines.en: We raise and lower our hands as one

lines.zh: 我们的脚步合成一个声音
lines.en: Our steps merge into one sound

lines.zh: 被围住的人开始害怕了
lines.en: The one we surround is afraid now
We need no language
It moves, and I follow

lines.zh: 我们一起记住了你的位置
lines.en: Together we memorize where you are
Tonight we are many
I take it from the ground
It has light; I don't like it
I wrap it in shadow
It fades out in my palm

lines.zh: 我举起来照了照自己，什么也没有
lines.en: I hold it up to myself and see nothing

lines.zh: 我把它放到另一道影子旁
lines.en: I set it beside another shadow
It's still bright; that's a problem
I let go and it falls
This thing is of use to you

lines.zh: 我拿走它，你少一个光源
lines.en: I take it, and you have one less light
You put out the torch
Now it's my turn to see you
We come from three directions
There's no light where we're heading

lines.zh: 我抬手，另一道影子也抬手
lines.en: I raise a hand; another shadow does too

lines.zh: 你打我一个，会碰到三个
lines.en: Strike one of us and you hit three
The fog has risen
Tonight we come for you

lines.zh: 你要跑，就往光是的地方
lines.en: Run, then; toward the light
We follow your shadow
I've taken the left
Never mind which is real; we all are
Your blade comes up too slowly

lines.zh: 我笑了，虽然你没有听到
lines.en: I laughed, though you didn't hear it
Roots are already down here
You can't go back now

lines.zh: 我们守在你周围，不靠近
lines.en: We ring you and keep our distance

lines.zh: 你往左，左边的影子就退
lines.en: You go left and the left shadow yields

lines.zh: 你追一个，后面两个跟着
lines.en: Chase one and two follow behind

lines.zh: 我们轮流靠近，不让你歇
lines.en: We take turns closing in, giving you no rest
Your flame is shrinking
We copy your breathing
You're hunting the original
Roots crawl slowly over the ground
Cut one root and two grow
Don't watch the shadows; watch your feet
We never move at once

lines.zh: 这一个退了，另一个就上来
lines.en: One falls back, another steps up
The fog is thick; you can't count
I'm one step from you

lines.zh: 你的刀砍到的都是空气
lines.en: Your blade finds only air
We wait for you to lose your rhythm

lines.zh: 灯灭了，就是你数错的时候
lines.en: The lamp goes out, and that's when you miscount
This night is longer than you think
I reach from your flank

lines.zh: 这一下打在你背上，很冷
lines.en: The blow lands on your back, and it's cold

lines.zh: 你转身，我已经在你背后
lines.en: You turn and I'm already behind you

lines.zh: 我的指甲在你臂上拉出白痕
lines.en: My nails draw white lines down your arm

lines.zh: 我们同时出手，你挡不住两边
lines.en: We strike together; you can't block both sides
The one you hit comes apart

lines.zh: 我的手指按住你的手腕
lines.en: My fingers close on your wrist
The shove leaves you stumbling
I'm a shadow — there's no end to me.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡得住刀，挡不住冷
lines.en: Armor stops a blade, not cold

lines.zh: 这一下你听见了声音，没人
lines.en: You heard that one, and there's no one
I've caught your cuff

lines.zh: 你退开两步，我退开三步
lines.en: You fall back two steps; I fall back three
We all withdraw and let you breathe

lines.zh: 这一下是真的，你流血了
lines.en: That one was real; you're bleeding
What you cut wasn't me
The fog comes first, then us

lines.zh: 我从你的影子里长出来
lines.en: I grow out of your shadow
Something moves under the roots

lines.zh: 我站在灯照不到的那面墙
lines.en: I stand on the wall the lamp misses

lines.zh: 你听见两声脚步，只有一个我
lines.en: You hear two footfalls and only one of me
We appear one after another
There's no moon tonight
I press to the wall behind you
Your lamp flickers once
I watch you through the door seam

lines.zh: 根从土里顶出来，一节一节
lines.en: Roots push up from the soil, joint by joint

lines.zh: 我抬手，另一个我也抬手
lines.en: I raise a hand; another me raises one too

lines.zh: 这间屋子现在有四个我
lines.en: There are four of me in this room now

lines.zh: 我不出声，等你自己发现
lines.en: I stay silent and let you find out
You turned full circle and I was always there
The lamp oil is nearly gone

lines.zh: 我们站在你与出口之间
lines.en: We stand between you and the way out
I've counted your lamps
The fire drives me back; I fear the light

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，散成一团
lines.en: I fall from the tree and scatter
Water washes me thin
The blast flashes and I'm nearly gone
The arrow passes through and leaves a hole

lines.zh: 魔法钉住我，另一道影子不动了
lines.en: Magic pins me and another shadow goes still

lines.zh: 太久没有光，我也快散了
lines.en: Too long without light, and I'm fading

lines.zh: 雷光照透整片林子，我无处可躲
lines.en: The flash lights the whole wood; nowhere to hide

lines.zh: 这里没有影子，我站不住
lines.en: No shadows here; I can't stand
